content:
[Intro]
[Bm]

[Verse 1]
[Bm]I was a [A]highwayman
Along the coach [G]roads I did ride
[Bm]
[A]With sword and [G]pistol by [D]my
[A]side
[Em]Many a young [Bm]maid lost her
[A]baubles to my trade [G]
[Em]Many a sol-
[Bm]dier shed his [A]lifeblood on my
[G]blade
[Bm]The bastards hung [A]me in the spring
[G]of [A]twentyfive [D]
But [Bm]I am still alive
[A]

[Verse 2]
[Bm]I was a [A]sailor
I was [G]born upon the
[Bm]tide
[A]And with the sea [G]I [D]did abide
[A]
[Em]I sailed a [Bm]schooner round the
[A]Horn to Mexico [G]
[Em]I went aloft
[Bm]and furled the [A]mainsail in a
[G]blow
[Bm]And when the yards [A]broke off they
[G]said that I [A]got [D]killed
But [Bm]I am living
[A]still

[Verse 3]
[Bm]I was a dam [A]builder
Across the [G]river deep and
[Bm]wide
[A]Where steel and [G]water did [D]col-
[A]lide
[Em]A place called [Bm]Boulder on the
[A]wild [G]Colorado
[Em]I slipped and
[Bm]fell into the wet [A]concrete below
[G]
[Bm]They buried me [A]in that great
[G]tomb that [A]knows no [D]sound
But [Bm]I am still around
[A]I'll
always be a-

[Chorus]
[D]round and [D/C#]around and a-
[Bm]round and [A]around and a-
[G]round and [D/F#]around
[Em]
[G]  [A]  [D]

[Verse 4]
[Bm]I fly a [A]starship
Across the [G]Universe divide
[Bm]
[A]And when I [G]reach the [D]other
[A]side
[Em]I'll find a place [Bm]to rest my
[A]spirit if I [G]can
[Em]Perhaps I may
[Bm]become a [A]highwayman again
[G]
[Bm]Or I may [A]simply be a
[G]single drop [A]of [D]rain
[Bm]But I will remain
[A]And
I'll be back again,

[Chorus]
[D]and [D/C#]again and a-
[Bm]gain and [A]again and a-
[G]gain and [D/F#]again
[Em]
[G]  [A]  [D]
[A]  [D]
